textContent:
Hsin has arranged a task for Suoming, asking you to join her in recording the sights of the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou.
A trip "down memory lane" that draws out the long-sealed memories of the Ten Seals Covenant…
 
✦Duration✦
Permanently available after Version 3.7 update.
 
✦Rewards✦
Astrite x180, Advanced Resonance Potion x8, Advanced Sealed Tube x8, Advanced Energy Core x8, Shell Credit x180000
 
✦Eligibility✦
Complete Main Quest "Simulacrum of the Heart: Epilogue" to unlock.
 
✦Event Rules✦
- A total of 6 Chrono Traces are scattered throughout the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou.
- Explore areas according to the clues and snap the correct photo or search the target location to complete Collection tasks and claim the rewards.
 
※Scale of Past can still be accessed via the event page or Trace Scale.
textTitle: [Past Dreams, Traced Seals] Photo Collection Event
